name: @intellectual-frontiers/docs
description: IFC Docs: the generator of a repository's documentation site, made from its TypeScript and its spec kit alone: typed configuration, an API reference for every export, the specifications with the tests that prove them, and lenses for layered models, programs, guides and releases; one command, ifc-docs, builds or checks the static site.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun ../libraries/src/shard.ts suite && bun ../libraries/src/shard.ts --first bun src/main.ts check && bun ../libraries/src/shard.ts --first bun tools/pack.ts --check
